title.text: Since before the financial crisis, churn has fallen in almost every region, whatever its productivity growth
subtitle: Change in real GVA per hour (chained volume, 2022 prices) and in the job reallocation rate, each against the pre-crisis years 2004–08.
Each dot is an ITL2 region; grey line = fit across all regions. Results similar excluding 2020–21 (COVID). Northern Ireland excluded (no data before 2011).
Sources: ONS Longitudinal Business Database (Secure Access, SN 9501); ONS Subregional productivity (June 2025); authors' calculations.
